title: AC1021 FIELD raw-carrier evaluator inventory across existing AutoCAD sources
scope: Correlate libdxfrw's current typed versus raw-only FIELD publication with independently decoded FIELD/FIELDLIST membership and evaluator IDs in three existing AC1021 sources. Identify the source-specific raw-carrier families that the next bounded implementation slices must preserve.

primaryAuthority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

localCarrierProbe.method: Count complete typed FIELD handles from dx_data and correlate the raw FIELD callbacks by handle. Match raw-only handles to LibreDWG minJSON FIELD evaluator IDs.

sourceProfiles.recheckNote: This reuses the same source hash as the 2026-11-11 screen. It refines evaluator-to-raw-only mapping and the current parser diagnostics; it is not a new producer source or independent wire-span evidence.

repeatedFamilies.AcObjProp.16.2: present among raw-only records in the metric source and all 56 raw-only records in the imperial source
repeatedFamilies.AcSm: present among raw-only records in the metric and architectural sources

findings.additionalFamily: AcVar appears among five architectural raw-only records.
findings.decision: S31's four parser-fallback counts describe one drawing only; they are not an exhaustive AC1021 FIELD category list. Inventory each raw-only FIELD by source profile and evaluator before selecting parser work. Prioritize a repeated family only after a representative object's source cursor and ODA layout explain its first decode divergence.

limits: Independent minJSON establishes object/evaluator inventory and FIELDLIST membership only; this receipt does not provide per-object body/string/handle cursor spans for raw-only carriers.
Parser diagnostic counts are emitted messages, not a one-to-one mapping to unique FIELD records; messages can overlap within one record.
The architectural drawing is a repeat of the same hash screened on 2026-11-11, not new producer evidence.
Neither source reached strict DXF output; no serializer eligibility, semantic FIELD evaluation, graph closure, fresh DXF readback, or native behavior is established.
All DWG and minJSON artifacts remain in existing user corpus or /private/tmp; no fixture or derivative was added to the repository.

closed: Map raw-only FIELD evaluator families in three existing AC1021 sources and verify all FIELDLIST member counts against independent minJSON.
Identify that AcObjProp.16.2 and AcSm recur across two sources, while AcVar appears in the architectural source.
remaining: For one representative raw-only member of a repeated family, bind source object identity, body/string/handle cursor, and following-object boundary before changing the parser.
Decode and preserve every source FIELDLIST member, including AcObjProp, AcObjProp.16.2, AcSm, and AcVar payloads and references.
Only after complete carrier coverage, add the legacy embedded TABLE/MTEXT plus nested-dictionary publication bridge and close strict output/readback/failure/retry.
implementationReadiness.nextAction: This inventory is closed. Do not expand the hash-bound AutoCAD 2007 P5-B target to the imperial or architectural drawings. Follow the target-scoped metric FIELD 0x3a5be next step in the plan and S33 screen; revisit other sources only when their own profile is admitted.
